select from asset_link l
l.deleted_at is null and l.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and l.source_id = #{requirementId}
group by l.source_id
and bool_or(l.target_type = 'API' and l.target_id = #{apiId})
and bool_or(l.target_type = 'CASE' and l.target_id = #{caseId})
order by created_at desc
